ValidationRule.description: IM-86: Validation for start date can not be in past calendar year for Initiative included In Projections. IM-392:Start date validation is not relevant for Amendment
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: !$Setup.Bypass_Automation_Setting__c.IM_Initiative_Validation__c && AND( Include_in_Projections__c = TRUE, YEAR(Start_Date__c) < YEAR(TODAY()), RecordType.DeveloperName <> 'Amendment' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Start date can not be in past calendar year for Initiative included In Projections.
